summary: LiveOne, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Shares Issuance Agreement with BMI, its wholly-owned subsidiary Slacker, Inc., and BMI. The company agreed to issue 1,000,000 shares of common stock at a deemed price of $7.50 per share to satisfy music royalty payment obligations through March 31, 2027 under existing license agreements. The agreement extends the license term through December 31, 2027 with automatic yearly renewals. BMI is restricted from selling more than 5% of ADTV per trading day, with a minimum of 3,500 shares allowed. The company will receive no cash proceeds. This is a routine contractual payment arrangement, not a special situation.
